topic: Two-Minute Window Display Refresh That Doubles Walk-ins (Retail)
title: Two-Minute Window Refresh That Can Boost Walk‑Ins
title_options: Quick Window Refresh to Increase Walk‑Ins
Simple Window Swap That Drives Foot Traffic
description:
A tiny swap in your window can make curious people come inside. This short shows one practical tip you can do in under two minutes with almost no cost.

Examples for a bakery, a plumber and a nail salon, plus exact wording and cost so you can copy it and try it today.

scenes.narration: Swap one focal prop in your window. Add a clear reason to enter and a bold price or offer.
Bakery: put a chalkboard in the window reading 'Morning special: 2 croissants $5. Today only.' Cost: chalk $1.
Plumber: place a bright card 'Free leak check today — $0' with a large phone number. One minute to print.
Nail salon: swap décor for a printed card 'Walk‑in mani $25' on an easel. Takes two minutes, cost about $1 to print.
Try it now: change one focal item, update clear price and reason to enter, then watch foot traffic. Follow Blue Ocean Marketing for one marketing fix every day.
